Hi Alex / Bethany —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost for batch report generation and improve tail latency for live transcripts.
- Key stakeholders: Alex (infra/ops), Bethany (product/ML eval), potential CTO availability for a short technical check.
- Success signal: 20–30% per-token cost reduction while keeping 95th pct latency within existing SLOs.

Next step: a 30-minute product intro + light tech Q&A. To keep it tight for your teams, we recommend 2 stakeholder-focused options (one product-led + one infra-led). Can you confirm which of the two windows below works best? If neither, tell us any preferred times and we’ll adjust.

Option A — Product-first (short feature intro, use cases, evals):
- Tue Aug 1, 2028 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT

Option B — Infra-first (kernel/latency/quantization talk + ops questions):
- Wed Aug 2, 2028 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If the CTO or an engineering lead wants to join, we can extend to 45 min or add a quick follow-up. I’ve attached a one-page scope note and a 30-min agenda.

Proposed owners: Karthik will run the demo, Marissa will join for the deep-dive.

Thanks — call out a preference and I’ll send an invite.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
